# Duetto: tasks

Break the plan into a Spec Kit tasks.md; tasks marked [P] are independent and will be implemented concurrently.

1. The engine is in the sibling `duetto` skill: `duetto` below means `node "<skill-dir>/../duetto/engine/bin/duetto.mjs"`
   (`<skill-dir>` is this file's directory).
2. Run `duetto tasks [--feature <NNN|slug>] --detach`, passing along what the user gave you.
3. Drive the run exactly as `<skill-dir>/../duetto/reference/loop.md` describes until its status is `paused` (this
   phase is complete) or `done`: synthesis steps, questions for the user, failures, everything.
4. Then tell the user what the phase produced, linking the files under `specs/NNN-*/` (tasks.md, committed together with the spec and plan), and that
   the next step is `/duetto-implement` (optionally `/duetto-analyze` first).
